summary: An offer states a line item's money under the bare names unit_price and total instead of the pinned integer minor-unit keys.

expect.reason: A line item states its money as integer minor units under unit_price_minor and total_minor (Section 7.2). The bare names are refused rather than read, because the two conventions differ by a factor of one hundred and nothing in the message says which was meant: read as minor units these lines are $3.60 and $180.00, against the $360.00 and $18,000.00 the header's total_value of 1800000 shows the sender intended. A receiver that guessed would agree with the sender about every number and disagree about every amount.
